BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z.
